item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://cableteque.com/blog/build-bom-from-wire-harness-drawing","version_id":"1eafb0dcff5f6f5b8c341b6abe613a9a77ce26e7c0fc4eef73af6790f2ae7fe5","decision":"accept","reason":"This is a fresh, dated commercial source directly relevant to manufacturing design: Cableteque says its software extracts structured wire-harness BOMs from drawing packages, flags likely-missing compatible parts, and routes exceptions to an estimator. Its claim that KCM Cable reduced a complex quote from 18 hours to 45 minutes is a vendor-reported case study, not proof of reliable extraction or manufacturability; verification would require the source drawings, exception/error rates, review effort, and production outcomes. It is useful as an attributed market and workflow claim, while its stated compatibility checks define a narrower, testable capability than generic document reading.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
